name: pagination-cursors-p2
prompt: how do I paginate a feed so rows do not get skipped or repeated when new items are inserted while a user is scrolling

chunks.content: bust the catalog cache whenever a product is edited
the infinite-scroll sentinel loads the next page when it enters the viewport
base64-encode the cursor payload so clients treat it as an opaque token and cannot tamper with the sort position
added a system-default dark theme option
added a covering index on (created_at, id) so the seek query stays an index range scan
require email verification before a new account can post
the activity feed joins posts with their authors and orders newest first
decided to page by an opaque cursor encoding the last row's sort key and id, so inserts above the reader's position do not shift later pages
the admin report still uses LIMIT and OFFSET because its dataset is tiny and never changes mid-read
the dashboard shows a total page count by dividing the row count by the page size
return X-RateLimit-Remaining on every API response
each request seeks to rows strictly after the supplied cursor with WHERE (created_at, id) < (:ts, :id), avoiding the skip bug that plain offsets cause when items are added
the cursor sorts on (created_at, id) so ties are broken deterministically and no row is duplicated across page boundaries
sign outgoing webhooks with an hmac the receiver can verify
